name: folic acid + vitamin d
uses: INDICATIONS AND DOSAGE Folixapure™ is indicated for dietary management of patients with unique nutritional needs requiring increased folate levels and Vitamin D supplementation. Folixapure™ can be taken by women of childbearing age, pregnant women, and lactating and nonlactating mothers.
contra: CONTRAINDICATIONS This product is contraindicated in patients with a known hypersensitivity to any of the ingredients. Folixapure™ is contraindicated in patients with hypercalcemia, malabsorption syndrome, abnormal sensitivity to the toxic effects of vitamin D, and hypervitaminosis D.
